This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

items.name: MCA Great Lakes Championship 2027

venue.name: [Alliant Energy Center](https://www.alliantenergycenter.com)
venue.address: 1919 Alliant Energy Center Way, Madison, WI 53713

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIzMDc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aabdae48f4634a533bea2176b824436ff472d06d/GLC-logo%20cropped.png)

This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2027.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MjM0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d094d9f0ae39cbbc76dac942c447b3fcd65b2323/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.
